name: flue-zoe-brain-2x
description: PARALLEL Flue 2.0.1 port of labs/flue-zoe-brain (which stays on @flue/*@1.0.0-beta.6 and remains the deployed sidecar on :3578). Separate directory ON PURPOSE: deploy.yml rebuilds and restarts flue-zoe-brain.service on ANY diff under labs/flue-zoe-brain/, and Flue 2.x rejects the wire contract the live zoe-data client speaks AND performs a one-way v5->v8 store migration. Nothing here deploys; cutover is a deliberate, separate operator step.
